_comment: Maintainer-decision dispositions for issue #731 (vendor-radar needs-human, 2026-11-16). The scan's triage evidence is quoted on the issue itself; this review adds the decision layer after a keyless GitHub API recheck of every repository on 2026-11-16. The parked candidate is recorded in open-rankings/arena-roadmap.json candidateProducts and is not ranked. No roster, verdict, or score changes.

dispositions.name: db-branch
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: rechecked live 2026-11-16. The README opens "Instant database branches for MySQL and PostgreSQL, on your own servers" and describes copy-on-write database branches on ZFS clones with ProxySQL routing. A database branching tool is not an AI code review agent; the lexical match (branch, ci, agent) is noise against the ai-code-review definition. The tripped stars-per-contributor floor (issue #731: 29 stars / 1 contributor on a repo created 2026-11-13; 54 stars at recheck) is moot for this arena and noted for any future renomination.
evidence: https://api.github.com/repos/db-branch/db-branch — fetched 2026-11-16; description "Instant MySQL database branches on ZFS clones, clustered across VMs with ProxySQL routing"; stars=54 created=2026-11-13 forks=1 language=Go.

https://api.github.com/repos/db-branch/db-branch/readme — fetched 2026-11-16; "Test a migration, let an AI agent loose, or give every pull request its own copy of the database." The agent/PR mentions are use cases for database branches, not a review product.
open-rankings/categories.json ai-code-review definition: AI code review agents for every pull request: summaries, bug catching, and standards enforcement.

dispositions.name: gputaskman
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: rechecked live 2026-11-16. The repository describes "A GPU task manager for Windows, Linux, and WSL: per-process VRAM, GPU activity, and LLM model/KV-cache insights". A monitoring tool that observes GPU and model memory usage does not run large language models on local hardware, so the local-llm-runtimes definition is not met. The young-repo velocity flag is consistent with a widely followed author (20 contributors, 169 forks) and is moot given the arena-fit failure.
evidence: https://api.github.com/repos/shanselman/gputaskman — fetched 2026-11-16; description "A GPU task manager for Windows, Linux, and WSL: per-process VRAM, GPU activity, and LLM model/KV-cache insights for NVIDIA"; stars=3415 created=2026-11-03 forks=169 language=Python.
open-rankings/categories.json local-llm-runtimes definition: Tools for running large language models on your own hardware across CPU, GPU, and Apple Silicon.

dispositions.name: Agweb
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: rechecked live 2026-11-16. Agweb is "A browser for coding agents on macOS, built on WebKit": a local desktop browser that agents drive from the shell, designed not to steal focus. It is not an isolated cloud execution environment where agents run untrusted code, so the agent-sandboxes definition is not met. The tripped stars-per-contributor floor (248 stars / 2 contributors on a repo created 2026-11-11 at recheck) is noted for any future renomination in another arena.
evidence: https://api.github.com/repos/paul-nameless/agweb — fetched 2026-11-16; description "A browser built for agents - no focus stealing, a tiny footprint, all tabs in one view."; stars=248 created=2026-11-11 forks=7 language=Swift.

https://api.github.com/repos/paul-nameless/agweb/readme — fetched 2026-11-16; "A browser for coding agents on macOS, built on WebKit (Safari's engine)"; agents drive one local window via the agweb CLI.
open-rankings/categories.json agent-sandboxes definition: Isolated cloud execution environments where AI agents safely run untrusted code.

dispositions.name: HGhub
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: the 2026-11-09 parking (reports/vendor-radar/2026-11-09-issue-669-review.json) stands. Rechecked live 2026-11-16: stars=9475 with forks=7822 on a repo created 2026-11-03, and the issue #731 triage measured ~724 stars/day, still above the 500/day anomaly floor; popularity remains unverifiable keylessly. The repository now describes itself as "Plug-in media player", which does not meet the device-agents definition either, so verified popularity alone would not qualify it. Not ranked; remains a device-agents candidate in open-rankings/arena-roadmap.json. Reconsideration requires a maintainer recheck of the popularity evidence and a new dated disposition before any approved bring-up.
evidence: https://api.github.com/repos/Minireel/HGhub — fetched 2026-11-16; description "Plug-in media player"; stars=9475 created=2026-11-03 forks=7822 language=Rust.
issue #731 — star velocity ~724/day exceeds the 500/day anomaly floor (2026-11-16 triage).

dispositions.name: kiri
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: rechecked live 2026-11-16. The repository describes "A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative". A container runtime with tunneling is not an agent that operates phones or computers through hardware or OS-level control; the lexical match (macos, windows, linux) is noise against the device-agents definition. The velocity flag (~547 stars/day on the issue #731 triage) is moot given the arena-fit failure and is noted for any future renomination.
evidence: https://api.github.com/repos/libracoder/kiri — fetched 2026-11-16; description "A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative"; stars=8719 created=2026-11-02 forks=381 language=Rust.
open-rankings/categories.json device-agents definition: Agents that operate real phones and computers through hardware or OS-level control.

dispositions.name: Turbo-Browser-MCP
dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: popularity unverifiable keylessly with a suspected inorganic pattern; manual maintainer recheck required when popularity can be verified. Rechecked live 2026-11-16: 125 stars against 1 contributor on a repo created 2026-11-14, far above the 20× stars-per-contributor floor for young repos. The product itself is plausibly on-axis for browser-agents (an npm-published Playwright MCP server with batched browser actions and form filling), so the row parks rather than skips. Not ranked; retained as a browser-agents candidate in open-rankings/arena-roadmap.json. Roadmap membership does not schedule another scan; a maintainer must recheck the popularity evidence and record a new dated disposition before any approved bring-up. Follows the pixelfx precedent (reports/2026-11-09-candidate-dispositions.md).
evidence: https://api.github.com/repos/Tthanh2k6/turbo-browser-mcp — fetched 2026-11-16; description "Playwright MCP server built to cut agent turns and tokens: one-call form filling, delta snapshots, batched steps"; stars=125 created=2026-11-14 forks=6 language=JavaScript.

https://api.github.com/repos/Tthanh2k6/turbo-browser-mcp/readme — fetched 2026-11-16; npm package turbo-browser-mcp, 11 MCP tools, CI badge; a working MCP surface, which is why the row parks instead of skipping.
issue #731 — repo younger than 60 days carries 117 stars against 1 contributor, above the 20× stars-per-contributor floor (2026-11-16 triage).

dispositions.reason: Maintainer decision: rechecked live 2026-11-16. vercel-labs/ui is "A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces": an SDK for agent-generated UI, not an autonomous support agent that resolves customer conversations end-to-end, so the ai-support-agents definition is not met.
